detaileddescription.para: Although iterating over the methods this way appears to violate the Java spec rule that instructs the compiler to "...get the list of methods seen from the class and get the most specific one...", it is in fact correct since ECJ has already chosen the correct function and what we are doing here is to look for a "perfect" mach with the function that was chosen. Lookup a member function in current class only (doesn't look in super and interfaces classes)

briefdescription.para: Support to get current class scope.
